Architecture, implementation status and motion

Illustrative target flow, not live execution. Every dashed wire is unintegrated on main. MAIN means an existing function, not a working end-to-end robot. BRANCH means code inspected on the named local branch; PLANNED means intended component or integration. Animated copies describe intended direction. They do not report real execution or throughput.

Listener text independently reaches the deterministic keyword check, crisis checker and Helper. The checker also receives recent turns. Helper receives session history, a policy snapshot fixed for the session, and eligible private notes loaded once. There is no Checker-to-Helper edge.

Release is code, not a model. Keyword match or a valid crisis result takes priority and discards the draft. The category is self, danger or unsure; keyword alone uses unsure. A draft is released only with no keyword and a valid none/concern check for the same session and turn. Checker timeout, failure or unreadable output gives the holding line; so does an unavailable draft with a valid noncrisis check. Two consecutive failed checks give offline text unless keyword/crisis priority applies. Late or wrong-turn checks never clear a draft.

Speaker is deliberately labelled audio output: docs discuss TTS and stored crisis/offline recordings, not a verified implementation that always synthesizes crisis text. The independent device-only cloud-unreachable path plays stored offline audio and bypasses cloud STT, Helper and Speaker.

Green electrical current illustrates the three existing audio-signal handoffs: Microphone → Listener, Speaker → Robot playback, and device-only Offline audio → Robot playback. These are native neon pulse primitives with green glow and a white-hot core, not recolored data particles. They loop indefinitely. The routes remain planned and dashed beneath the current; this is not a claim of physical power/network wiring or a working audio integration. Other semantic data routes are unchanged.

The lower panel is session lifecycle, not per-turn processing. Finished text turns, date and remembering consent reach Note-taker, which reads existing notes. Code applies add, replace, confirm and delete. Only live indexed notes can reach Helper; originals stay fixed. The six categories match NoteKind in schemas.py. Remember off permits deletes only. Forget everything blocks adds, replacements and confirms. No private-memory access is granted to Listener, Checker, Release, Speaker or training agents. Training transcript consent is separate.

Audit snapshot: main e5ea2a8; crisis-path 78377e4; notes 23cdbb8. Audio and session wiring are planned. Full engine baseline approval and slide-app playback are not claimed. See fig2-architecture.md and fig2-qa.json.
